calibration.promotion_rule: no literal candidate or review-packet case is emitted as a semantic edge

review_requirements: resolve URI syntax and effective base for each occurrence
confirm the target is in the same source document and uniquely identified
establish the XLink type/role or RDF predicate meaning
establish the target element type meaning
record reviewed positive and negative source cases before estimating match behavior
report.sampling_method: deterministic source-order examples within context strata; not a probability sample
